evals.name: demo-review-at-stage
evals.prompt: /songwriting:diagnose demo "<a chorus stanza only, with some cliche, some abstract lines>"
evals.expected_output: Routes to the demo action. Loads demo-review.md and templates/demo-review-prompt.md. Detects the completion stage (chorus only) and runs a stage-appropriate review rather than the full near-complete `diagnose` pass. Identifies the dominant problem — likely abstract telling or cliche — and proposes ONE focused next move, listing secondary observations briefly without fixing them.
expectations: Detects the completion stage as chorus-only (or similar partial state)
Runs the stage-appropriate demo review, NOT the full near-complete `diagnose` action
Lists secondary observations briefly (one line each) without fixing them
Names the response-filter Critique filter and Pre-lock filter status before emission

evals.name: audit-checklist-pre-lock
evals.prompt: /songwriting:diagnose audit "midnight pulled the streetlight down and threw it in the river"
evals.expected_output: Routes to the audit action. Loads audit-checklist.md and templates/audit-checklist-prompt.md. Walks the per-line audit clusters in order, presenting each as a deliberate choice point (pass/fail/skip-with-reason) rather than a pass/fail gate, and surfaces the first unchecked or dominant unresolved item.
expectations: Walks multiple per-line audit clusters (e.g. stress/meter, rhyme, image, cliche, POV, prosody)
Presents each box as a deliberate choice point (tool, not a rule)
Surfaces the first unchecked OR dominant unresolved item
Does NOT block on any box — names the skip option when a box is skipped

evals.name: variations-labeled
evals.prompt: /songwriting:diagnose variations "I keep walking past your door at night" — 5 versions, different POV, different image
evals.expected_output: Routes to the variations action. Loads variations.md and templates/variations-prompt.md. Generates 4-6 labeled variations, each with an explicit axis label (POV / image / vowel / stress / rhyme-type / tone) and a gains/loses trade-off, without picking a winner.
expectations: Each variation is explicitly labeled with an axis + shift (e.g. 'POV: 1st to 2nd')
Each variation states a gains/loses trade-off
Does NOT recommend a single best variation
If the writer asks for the 'best' one, pushes back asking for the load-bearing constraint
